notes: EcoreX v0.1.13 publishes macOS desktop DMGs built by the GitHub Actions macos-15 workflow, separate Windows/macOS one-click local WebUI packages, and rollout-compatible Admin API metadata. The Windows desktop NSIS installer remains pending SimplySign administrator signing and is not exposed as a ready download.

artifacts.source: Unsigned NSIS candidate built locally for v0.1.13 and verified as Authenticode NotSigned. Do not publish as ready until SimplySign/proCertum is unlocked in an elevated administrator process and Authenticode verifies as Valid.
Archived dual-platform package. The public download page exposes the separate Windows and macOS WebUI packages.
Contains embedded Windows Python runtime and Install EcoreX WebUI.cmd; copies to local app data, starts the WebUI, and opens /app/ in the default browser.

Contains macOS arm64/x64 Python standalone archives, offline wheels, and Install EcoreX WebUI.app. The installer runs in the background, writes logs under ~/Library/Application Support/EcoreX WebUI/state/, starts the WebUI without exposing the Agent CLI/runtime terminal, and opens /app/ in the default browser.
Web deployment package generated by scripts/prepare-ecorex-web-release.ps1; retained for server/operator use and not shown as a primary public card.
